Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of ambiguous task scope due to incomplete disambiguation between similar entities/contexts. The Planner incorrectly assumed that the English title "Gently My Songs Entreat" referred to the British film "Unfinished Symphony" (1934) directed by Anthony Asquith, rather than the primary 1933 Austrian-German film "Leise flehen meine Lieder" directed by Willi Forst. This error occurred in the first step of the conversation when the Planner analyzed the WebSurfer's initial results. Although the WebSurfer correctly identified the German title and director (Willi Forst) in the first search, the Planner ignored this primary match and instead focused on the secondary British version, leading to the investigation of the wrong director's birthplace.
